name: image_ocr
description: Extract text from an image using OCR. Use THIS TOOL when the user wants to read, analyze, or extract text from an image, photo, screenshot, or any image file. Accepts a local path, public URL, or base64-encoded image.

image_path.description: Local path to the image file, e.g. /tmp/image.png

image_url.description: Public URL of the image to analyze

image_base64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (without the data: prefix)

lang.description: Tesseract language code for OCR. E.g. 'fra' for French, 'eng' for English. Default: eng
